title: Continuous beam audio, Javelin range and shared finless ordnance
context: The owner reported repeated beam-sound attacks, unusable long-range Quiver locking and a Mortar that needed indirect-fire feedback; they requested finless green missile-derived ammunition for both Mortar and Tank.
outcome: Beam loops use a pinned sustain-only crossfade sample. Sniper labels a Quiver/Javelin prototype with 1000 m acquisition, one manual shot per lock and unchanged damage; automated stats are unchanged. Mortar aims through a translucent overhead map and records actual ballistic ground-impact splash circles. Its physical shell shares one 76-triangle olive DART-derived factory with Tank, Sentry and Units. A range-reset disposal bug discovered during acceptance was fixed so the Mortar map survives resets. Source-derived shell files reproduce byte-for-byte with scripts/derive-shell.mjs.
evidence: npm run check, npm run build, npm run test:browser passed (source)
node scripts/browser-test.mjs --sniper passed all eight weapons, continuous loop-buffer assertion, 500 m Javelin arrival, Mortar map survival and landing feedback, draft isolation and disposal
npm run assets:check passed after shell regeneration
